name: Wawp – Order Notifications, OTP Verification, Advanced Country Code, and Chat widget for WooCommerce
author: 101Gen

sections.description:
Wawp is a powerful communication bridge that connects your WordPress site directly to WhatsApp. Whether you want to provide instant customer support or automate your WooCommerce order workflow, Wawp makes it seamless.

With Wawp, you can move away from traditional emails that get lost in spam and reach your customers where they are most active. From secure OTP logins to interactive WhatsApp chat buttons, this plugin is designed to boost conversion and build trust.

Note: A Wawp account is required to use this plugin. Create a free account and send up to 250 WhatsApp messages per month for free.

Free Features

  • WhatsApp Web Integration: Connect your existing WhatsApp number quickly using a simple QR code scan.
  • SMTP Configuration: Use your own SMTP settings to ensure reliable delivery of system-related emails.
  • WhatsApp Order Notifications: Send instant automated messages to customers when their WooCommerce order status changes.
  • WhatsApp OTP Login: Enhance security and simplify user experience by allowing users to login via WhatsApp One-Time Passwords.
  • Registration Form Builder: Create custom registration forms that integrate directly with your WhatsApp communication flow.
  • Advanced Phone Field: Add a smart phone input field with country flags and auto-prefixing to your forms.
  • WhatsApp Chat Button: Add a customizable floating chat widget to your site so customers can message you instantly.

Pro Features

  • WhatsApp Business API Integration: Connect via official Meta Cloud API for high-volume, professional messaging.
  • WhatsApp Bulk Campaigns: Send broadcast messages and marketing campaigns to your customers.
  • Abandoned Cart Recovery: Automatically follow up with customers who left items in their cart via WhatsApp.
  • Woo Subscriptions Notifications: Fully compatible with WooCommerce Subscriptions for renewal and status alerts.
  • Multilingual Notifications: Send messages in the customer’s preferred language.
  • Woo Checkout Verification: Verify customer phone numbers via OTP directly on the checkout page to reduce fake orders.
  • Advanced Sending Logs: Access detailed reports and delivery statuses for every message sent from your site.

View Pricing & Upgrade

Ready to scale your business? Unlock the full power of WhatsApp marketing and automation.
View Pricing and Upgrade to Pro →

External Services

This plugin relies on the following third-party services to provide core functionality:

  1. Wawp.net (Core Service Provider)

    • Service: Wawp.net API
    • Purpose: Handles WhatsApp QR linking, message delivery gateway, and license validation.
    • Data Sent: Site URL, API tokens, Instance IDs, recipient phone numbers, and message content.
    • Privacy: Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

  2. Meta (Facebook Graph API)

    • Service: WhatsApp Cloud API
    • Purpose: Used for users who choose the official Meta Business sender channel.
    • Data Sent: Recipient phone numbers and message templates.
    • Privacy: Meta Privacy Policy

  3. IP-API.com

    • Service: Geolocation API
    • Purpose: Identifies visitor country in the Abandoned Cart module for store analytics.
    • Data Sent: Visitor IP address.
    • Privacy: Terms & Privacy

  4. Ipapi.co

    • Service: Geolocation API
    • Purpose: Auto-detects visitor country for the “Advanced Phone Field” and “Chat Widget.”
    • Data Sent: Visitor IP address.
    • Privacy: Terms & Privacy

  5. FlagCDN

    • Service: FlagCDN
    • Purpose: Provides flag icons for the Abandoned Cart dashboard interface.
    • Data Sent: Standard HTTP request (no personal data).
    • Privacy: Terms of Service

Quick Links & Resources

sections.installation:
How to Start

  1. Install and activate the Wawp plugin.
  2. Create a free account on Wawp.net.
  3. Connect your WhatsApp number by scanning the QR code in the Wawp dashboard.
  4. Copy your API keys and Instance ID and paste them into the plugin settings.
  5. Customize your notification templates and start sending!1. Install using the WordPress built-in Plugin installer, or Extract the zip file and drop the contents in the wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress installation.
  6. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  7. Create new account on Wawp.net
  8. Connect your whatsapp with qr code in Wawp dashboard
  9. Add instances in Wawp plugin in the wp-admin/admin.php?page=wawp&awp_section=instances
  10. Now you can automate your conversations, and unlock WhatsApp superpowers.

For documentation and tutorials visit our Knowledge Base.
sections.faq:
How do I get started with Wawp?

Simply install our free plugin on your WordPress site, connect your WhatsApp number, and configure your preferred features. Read our detailed guide.

Is Wawp Free?

Yes, Wawp offers a free plan that includes 200 free messages each month. You can upgrade to the Pro plan to send more messages.

Do I need to signup for WhatsApp API?

No, you do not need WhatsApp API at all. Wawp is simple to use and is affordable.

Are there any additional costs by WhatsApp?

There is no additional payment taken by WhatsApp to use Wawp.

Can I use Wawp for multiple WhatsApp numbers?

Yes, Wawp supports unlimited sites and multiple WhatsApp numbers, making it ideal for businesses with diverse operations.

Can I disconnect my WhatsApp number?

Yes, Wawp allows you to disconnect your WhatsApp number with just one click, giving you complete control over your account.

short_description: Wawp Automate notifications, Enable Chat widget, Country Code, secure store with OTP verification, and more.
description:
Wawp is a powerful communication bridge that connects your WordPress site directly to WhatsApp. Whether you want to provide instant customer support or automate your WooCommerce order workflow, Wawp makes it seamless.

With Wawp, you can move away from traditional emails that get lost in spam and reach your customers where they are most active. From secure OTP logins to interactive WhatsApp chat buttons, this plugin is designed to boost conversion and build trust.

Note: A Wawp account is required to use this plugin. Create a free account and send up to 250 WhatsApp messages per month for free.

Free Features

  • WhatsApp Web Integration: Connect your existing WhatsApp number quickly using a simple QR code scan.
  • SMTP Configuration: Use your own SMTP settings to ensure reliable delivery of system-related emails.
  • WhatsApp Order Notifications: Send instant automated messages to customers when their WooCommerce order status changes.
  • WhatsApp OTP Login: Enhance security and simplify user experience by allowing users to login via WhatsApp One-Time Passwords.
  • Registration Form Builder: Create custom registration forms that integrate directly with your WhatsApp communication flow.
  • Advanced Phone Field: Add a smart phone input field with country flags and auto-prefixing to your forms.
  • WhatsApp Chat Button: Add a customizable floating chat widget to your site so customers can message you instantly.

Pro Features

  • WhatsApp Business API Integration: Connect via official Meta Cloud API for high-volume, professional messaging.
  • WhatsApp Bulk Campaigns: Send broadcast messages and marketing campaigns to your customers.
  • Abandoned Cart Recovery: Automatically follow up with customers who left items in their cart via WhatsApp.
  • Woo Subscriptions Notifications: Fully compatible with WooCommerce Subscriptions for renewal and status alerts.
  • Multilingual Notifications: Send messages in the customer’s preferred language.
  • Woo Checkout Verification: Verify customer phone numbers via OTP directly on the checkout page to reduce fake orders.
  • Advanced Sending Logs: Access detailed reports and delivery statuses for every message sent from your site.

View Pricing & Upgrade

Ready to scale your business? Unlock the full power of WhatsApp marketing and automation.
View Pricing and Upgrade to Pro →

External Services

This plugin relies on the following third-party services to provide core functionality:

  1. Wawp.net (Core Service Provider)

    • Service: Wawp.net API
    • Purpose: Handles WhatsApp QR linking, message delivery gateway, and license validation.
    • Data Sent: Site URL, API tokens, Instance IDs, recipient phone numbers, and message content.
    • Privacy: Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

  2. Meta (Facebook Graph API)

    • Service: WhatsApp Cloud API
    • Purpose: Used for users who choose the official Meta Business sender channel.
    • Data Sent: Recipient phone numbers and message templates.
    • Privacy: Meta Privacy Policy

  3. IP-API.com

    • Service: Geolocation API
    • Purpose: Identifies visitor country in the Abandoned Cart module for store analytics.
    • Data Sent: Visitor IP address.
    • Privacy: Terms & Privacy

  4. Ipapi.co

    • Service: Geolocation API
    • Purpose: Auto-detects visitor country for the “Advanced Phone Field” and “Chat Widget.”
    • Data Sent: Visitor IP address.
    • Privacy: Terms & Privacy

  5. FlagCDN

    • Service: FlagCDN
    • Purpose: Provides flag icons for the Abandoned Cart dashboard interface.
    • Data Sent: Standard HTTP request (no personal data).
    • Privacy: Terms of Service
